newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 16 to 18 bln Ffr BTANs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 16 to 18 bln Ffr BTANs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 16 and 18 billion francs of government bonds (BTANs) at its next scheduled auction on November 21, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the 4.50 percent October 12, 1998 BTAN, with a payment date of December 5, the statement said.
The Treasury also said it would offer the 5.50 percent October 12, 2001 BTAN, with a payment date of December 12.
